The '''27th Producers Guild of America Awards'''<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.producersguild.org/page/2016award_winners|title=2016 PGA Awards Winners - Producers Guild of America|website=www.producersguild.org|access-date=November 24, 2016|archive-date=September 16, 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200916155645/http://www.producersguild.org/page/2016award_winners|url-status=dead}}</ref> (also known as '''2016 Producers Guild Awards'''), honoring the best [[Film producer|film]] and [[television producer]]s of 2015, were held at the [[The Century Plaza Hotel|Hyatt Regency Century Plaza]] in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] on January 23, 2016. The nominations for documentary film were announced on November 23, 2015,<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title='Amy,' 'The Hunting Ground' Nominated for Producers Guild's Documentary Award|url=https://variety.com/2015/film/news/producers-guild-documentary-nominees-amy-hunting-ground-1201646799/|accessdate=January 3, 2016|work=[[Variety (magazine)|Variety]]|date=November 23, 2015|language=en-US|archive-date=January 4, 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160104234039/http://variety.com/2015/film/news/producers-guild-documentary-nominees-amy-hunting-ground-1201646799/|url-status=live}}</ref> and the nominations for television were announced on December 8, 2015.<ref name=TVnoms>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=Producers Guild Unveils TV
